_comment: The allowlist for claude-agent. Repositories not listed here are never touched.
trigger is one of: actions (driven by the caller workflow in that repository),
poller (the launchd job on the mac mini looks every five minutes), or both.
verify_hint is pasted into the prompt to say how work is verified in that repo.
ignore_workflows names claude-agent's own workflows, so it never tries to fix
its own failure and loop forever.

repos.verify_hint: Run nix fmt to format, just docs to regenerate the generated README blocks, and check that nix eval .#darwinConfigurations.<host>.system (or nixosConfigurations.<host>.config.system.build.toplevel) still evaluates for any host you touched. just docs is mandatory after changing the Justfile: CI has failed on README drift before.

workers: cd apps/workers && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run. iOS: cd apps/ios/TsuzuriCore && swift build (the mac mini has no XCTest, so swift test cannot run; the compile check is as far as it goes).
repos._note: No caller workflow yet. The repository still carries the old, dead claude-auto-fix.yml and watchdog.yml, which need removing before a caller is added; that is someone else's organisation, so it waits for a decision.
